body: There is asecret that is infinitely greater than anything you have ever known. It is real and it exists and if you make room for it —it will overwhelm you. You have to get out of the way You have to abandon everything you've been taught and ever)'thing you've been led to believe —all those limiting, confining, imprisoning, denying ideas and concepts that you have picked up along your way. You have to make room for that which is unbelievable. You have to gel out of the way. "Oh my God!" you'll say, "I didn't know it could be like this," 1 2
